npcs.name: Barnaby
npcs.description: An elderly, genial seagull scholar standing upright on webbed feet, outfitted in a faded navy sailor cap, brass-rimmed miniature spectacles perched on his beak, and a weathered leather satchel bulging with rolled nautical chart remnants.

style.artDirection: Classic 2D JRPG pixel art with a consistent palette and crisp square pixels
style.worldDescription: A compact coastal homestead set at sunrise. In the upper-left sits a cozy single-story timber cottage adjoining an open-door windmill workshop housing an antique copper cauldron. Beside it, four neat farm plots display glowing sea herbs, ripe golden carrots, round pumpkins, and wild blossoms bordered by low split-rail fences and fruit trees. A broad sandy footpath cuts through the center toward a weathered plank pier at the water's edge. Along the lower and eastern margins, turquoise tide pools lap against low rugged cliffs where sea herbs glow faintly in the sea mist.

title: The Witch's Tide and Golden Sight

player.name: Molly
player.description: A chibi yordle witch with 1.5-head-tall proportions, wearing an oversized floppy pale blush-pink pointed witch hat with a drooping curved tip. She has fluffy muted rose-mauve bangs, pointed furry elf ears poking outward, dot-matrix eyes, and no visible neck. Her outfit combines a soft lavender capelet, deep indigo inner dress, warm cream collar with subtle gold star trim, a worn leather satchel, a crooked dark-brown staff, and charcoal-purple shoes.

scenes.title: The Windmill Shore

dialogue.text: Squawk! Midnight's gale blew my heirloom navigation charts clear into the deep brine, little Molly!
dialogue.speaker: Barnaby

dialogue.text: Don't despair, Barnaby. The Potion of Golden Sight will reveal your lost channel in the mind's eye.
dialogue.speaker: Molly

dialogue.text: A scholar's blessing upon you! The copper cauldron waits swept and ready inside the windmill workshop.
dialogue.speaker: Barnaby

dialogue.text: You will find a sun-ripened Golden Carrot in your garden plot, and glowing sea herbs down by the cliff tide pools.
dialogue.speaker: Barnaby

dialogue.text: Mind the two pinch-happy crabs scuttling by the wet sand—a tap from your crooked staff should keep them at bay!
dialogue.speaker: Barnaby

dialogue.text: I'll gather the carrot and herbs along the coastal path, brew the draught at the windmill, and return before dusk.
dialogue.speaker: Molly

scenes.location: Cottage farmstead and coastal bluffs overlooking the morning sea
scenes.objective: Speak with Barnaby at the pier and locate the ingredients for the Potion of Golden Sight across the farm and shoreline.

minions.name: Tidepool Crab
minions.description: A mischievous coastal crab with a muted coral-orange shell, two prominent snapping pincers, small beady eyes on stalks, and short scuttling legs in a compact animal silhouette.

minions.name: Shell Crab
minions.description: A sturdy little shore crab with a dusty turquoise carapace, pair of front claws, beady stalk eyes, and a low scuttling posture along the sandy wet verge.

openingRemarks: A cozy, compact 2D coastal exploration scene featuring apprentice witch Molly and the scholar seagull Barnaby, framed with classic pixel art aesthetics and gentle narrative environmental storytelling.
